requirements.quote:
attack.  Therefore, QUIC endpoints ignore the ECN field in an IP
   packet unless at least one QUIC packet in that IP packet is
   successfully processed; see Section 13.4.
requirements.condition: No QUIC packet in the IP packet is successfully processed.
requirements.required_behavior: The QUIC endpoint ignores the ECN field in that IP packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The QUIC endpoint must not use the ECN field from an IP packet when none of its QUIC packets was successfully processed.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can supply an IP packet whose contained QUIC packets all fail processing and verify that its ECN field does not affect endpoint behavior.
